rounds.clue: What you were on the day we met.
rounds.note: You walked in like you already belonged there.

rounds.clue: Where we got lost on purpose.
rounds.note: Every wrong turn was the right one that week.

rounds.clue: How many years we've been at this.
rounds.note: Still counting, still choosing each other.

rounds.clue: The thing playing when you said yes.
rounds.note: I hear that song differently now.

closing.title: Thank you for playing
body: These five words barely cover it, but they were the ones I kept coming back to.
Here's to many more rounds — the easy ones and the hard ones — together.
